title: Red-haired Punk Rocker
description: A stylized female character with voluminous, spiky red hair tied with a purple bandana stands in a dynamic pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears a red leather-like crop top, red shorts, a black belt with pouches, a red cape with gold fringe, and tall red platform boots.
prompt: Full body view of a fierce female punk rocker with massive spiky bright red hair in a high ponytail with purple accents and a red bandana. She has dramatic makeup, wears a red studded crop top, red leather shorts, black utility belt, and a short red cape with golden fringe. She stands in an aggressive wide stance with arms outstretched, wearing tall shiny red platform combat boots. Vibrant colors, clean cel-shaded digital art style, solid dark gray background.
